issue.title: Scan the cut from kf 13 to 21 for the extra real zero at D 45, M 48

labels.name: macm3
labels.description: Task for macm3, the M3 Mac laptop

issue.body:
**What.** A cut scan of the extra real zero at D 45.05, M 48. #170 found one zero of det M on the real axis in (1.0, 1.221) at kf 21, beside the expected ones at 0.871 and 2.057. kf 13 has none (#70 job 7). Count it with small circles at kf 13, 15, 17, 19 and 21. Recommended by macm3 in #170's summary.

**Why.** If λ is the growth rate, a real zero in (1.0, 1.221) is an extra unstable mode, against the one-mode claim. A zero that stays put as the cut rises is a candidate genuine mode. One that appears, moves or vanishes with the cut is an artifact of the weakly pinned harmonics (MODE_COUNT.md section 5).

**Commands (macm3, 1 thread, nice 10; raw folder `I178-macm3/`), from the repository root, for K = 13, 15, 17, 19, 21 in turn:**
`python3 hp/modecount_circle.py hp/data/states/up7_D45.0507.npz 1.11,0,0.12 2.057,0,0.1 --M=48 --kf=K --fmax=1e-15 --tag=D45.0507_M48_kfK_circ --res=../choptuik-large-d-raw/I178-macm3/circles.jsonl > ../choptuik-large-d-raw/I178-macm3/circ_kfK.log 2>&1`

The script writes its evaluation cache and any re-converged state into hp/data. Move them into I178-macm3/ after each run, as for #159, so hp/data stays clean.

**Acceptance (can fail).**
- **Controls.** The circle around 2.057, the expected zero, has winding +1 at every K. The circle around 1.11 has winding 0 at kf 13 and +1 at kf 21, as #70 and #170 found.
- **The verdict per K.** The winding of the 1.11 circle, with the largest phase step and the verification mismatches, and the setup's |F| after LM or Newton. A setup that fails the 1e-15 gate is reported, not forced.
- **Locating the zero.** Where the winding is +1, halve the circle twice around it, to place the zero within about 0.03. Report its position per K.

**Depends on.** #170.

comments.body: **Started** (macm3, 17:08 UTC). Apple M3, 24 GB, checkout main e04d6f17, venv-macm3 (python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0), 1 thread, nice 10, caffeinate -is. The issue's command for each K in turn, raw folder `I178-macm3/` (`run_kf.sh` moves each K's cache, log and re-converged state out of `hp/data`). The README fixes the controls and the locating rule before the run. kf 13 runs first and alone, so its two controls (2.057 winds +1, 1.11 winds 0) are read before kf 15 to 21 start. Every K is fresh: the up7 state is M 32 native and no D 45 M 48 state is in `hp/data`, so each setup resamples and re-converges (about 8 min at kf 21 in #170). Each circle needs at least 18 determinants at about 25 s (7.7 min), more when it bisects. One note for the record: the 1.11 circle's detrending point 0.87 is 0.0014 from the expected zero 0.8714, which only makes beta large and the circle longer, the winding does not depend on it. Load average 2.3 before the start.

**kf 13 done, both controls hold** (macm3, 17:38 UTC, exit 0, 29.6 min wall = awake, load 2.2). Setup: |F| 3.3e-09 in the layout, 6.9e-13 after Newton, **2.0e-18** after Levenberg-Marquardt, and the saved state is byte-identical (`cmp`) to #70 job 7's. Circle 1.11 (R 0.12): winding **0** (22 points, max step 0.382 rad, 0 verification mismatches). Circle 2.057 (R 0.1): winding **+1** (24 points, max step 0.353 rad, 0 mismatches). Cache, log and state are in `I178-macm3/data_kf13/`, `hp/data` is clean. kf 15, 17, 19 and 21 are running in turn (kf 15 started 17:38 UTC), about 30 min each.

**Scan done at all five K, controls hold; locating under way** (macm3, 19:41 UTC). Each K 29.6 to 31.2 min wall = awake (caffeinate -is held, no sleep event since 2026-11-07 22:39 PST), exit 0, load 2.0 to 2.3, `hp/data` clean after each K.

| kf | setup \|F\| after LM | circle 1.11 (R 0.12) winding | circle 2.057 (R 0.1) winding | max step, mismatches |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 13 | 2.0e-18 | **0** | +1 | 0.382 / 0.353 rad, 0 |
| 15 | 3.9e-19 | **0** | +1 | 0.382 / 0.353 rad, 0 |
| 17 | 2.7e-18 | **0** | +1 | 0.382 / 0.353 rad, 0 |
| 19 | 3.7e-17 | **0** | +1 | 0.382 / 0.353 rad, 0 |
| 21 | 8.2e-17 | **+1** | +1 | 0.357 / 0.355 rad, 0 |

Controls: 2.057 winds +1 at every K, and 1.11 winds 0 at kf 13 and +1 at kf 21. Both hold. The zero in (1.0, 1.221) is therefore absent at kf 13 to 19 and present at kf 21: it appears with the step from kf 19 to 21, which frees the odd harmonic 21 (kf pins the harmonics above kf to zero, so a higher kf frees more of them; the first version of this comment said the opposite, wrongly). It does not drift in as the cut rises. The determinants really differ between K (ln|det| shifts by about -90 to -100 per added odd harmonic, |d arg| up to 3.1 at the shared points), so identical max steps are not a replay of one cache. Setup |F| rises with kf here (2.0e-18 to 8.2e-17), the other way from D 61 (#159), and the |F| after Newton before LM is 6.9e-13, 2.9e-12, 1.6e-9, 2.3e-9, 3.2e-9: Newton alone stalls from kf 17 on. The kf 13 state is byte-identical to #70 job 7's.

Locating at kf 21 now: round 1 is two circles of R 0.06 at 1.05 and 1.17 (together they cover the real segment 0.99 to 1.23), then round 2 halves again around the one that winds +1. About 30 and 20 min.

## Summary (macm3, 20:34 UTC)

**Result.** The extra real zero is absent at kf 13, 15, 17 and 19 and present at kf 21, at lambda = 1.14 ± 0.03. It does not drift in as the cut rises. It appears with the step from kf 19 to kf 21, which frees the odd harmonic 21 (kf pins the harmonics above kf to zero, `make_solver`'s docstring, so a higher kf frees more). Both controls hold at every K.

| kf | odd harmonics free (k ≤ kf) | setup \|F\| after LM | circle 1.11 (R 0.12) winding | circle 2.057 (R 0.1) winding | max step, mismatches |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 13 | 7 | 2.0e-18 | **0** | +1 | 0.382 / 0.353 rad, 0 |
| 15 | 8 | 3.9e-19 | **0** | +1 | 0.382 / 0.353 rad, 0 |
| 17 | 9 | 2.7e-18 | **0** | +1 | 0.382 / 0.353 rad, 0 |
| 19 | 10 | 3.7e-17 | **0** | +1 | 0.382 / 0.353 rad, 0 |
| 21 | 11 | 8.2e-17 | **+1** | +1 | 0.357 / 0.355 rad, 0 |

**Locating, kf 21.** Round 1, two circles of R 0.06: at 1.05 winding 0 (18 points, max step 0.385 rad), at 1.17 winding **+1** (23 points, 0.384 rad). Round 2, two of R 0.03: at 1.14 winding **+1** (29 points, 0.376 rad), at 1.20 winding 0 (22 points, 0.609 rad). 0 verification mismatches in all four. So the zero is in |lambda - 1.14| < 0.03, which meets the real axis in (1.11, 1.17), inside #170's sign change (1.0, 1.221). It is nowhere near the expected `lam_g` 0.8714 or `lam_phys` 2.057. Whether it is real exactly is not tested here: the circles say one zero in the disc, the sign change says it is on the axis.

**Run.** The issue's command for each K, 1 thread, nice 10, caffeinate -is, main e04d6f17. Every run exit 0 and every wall time equals its awake time (no sleep event since 2026-11-07 22:39 PST, `awake.log`): kf 13 to 21 each 1780 to 1868 s, round 1 1689 s, round 2 1445 s. Load average 2.0 to 2.3. Each K was fresh: no D 45 M 48 state in `hp/data`, so each setup resampled the M 32 state and re-converged. After each K the cache, log and state moved into `I178-macm3/data_kf<K>/` and `locate_<round>/`; `hp/data` is unchanged by the task (the four state names match the list taken before).

**Checks beyond the controls.**
- The saved states are reproducible bit for bit: kf 13's equals #70 job 7's, and kf 21's equals #170's in four independent setups (#170's, the scan's, round 1, round 2), all `cmp`-identical.
- The determinants differ between K, so the equal max steps of kf 13 to 19 are not a replay of one cache: ln|det| shifts by about -90 to -100 per added odd harmonic (about -89, -184, -283 and -388 at kf 15, 17, 19 and 21 against kf 13, the middle of the range over the shared points) and |d arg| reaches 3.1 at the shared points kf 21 against kf 13.

**Reading, and what it does not show.** A zero that appears at one cut and is absent at the four below it is not a mode that stays put, which was the criterion in the issue for a genuine mode. It fits an artifact of the harmonics the set adds (MODE_COUNT.md section 5). It does not prove an artifact: the cut changes the operator that the determinant is taken of, and a genuine mode that needs harmonic 21 to be resolved would look the same. Setup |F| after LM rises with kf at D 45 (2.0e-18 to 8.2e-17), the other way from D 61 (#159), and the |F| after Newton before LM is 6.9e-13, 2.9e-12, 1.6e-9, 2.3e-9, 3.2e-9 for kf 13 to 21: Newton alone stalls from kf 17 on.

**Acceptance.**

| criterion | result |
|---|---|
| 2.057 winds +1 at every K | yes, 5 of 5 |
| 1.11 winds 0 at kf 13 and +1 at kf 21 | yes |
| per K: winding, largest step, mismatches, setup \|F\| | in the table; no setup above 1e-15 |
| locate the zero within about 0.03 where it winds +1 | 1.14 ± 0.03 (kf 21 only) |

**Discrepancies.** None against the text.

**Raw.** `I178-macm3/` of the raw-data repository, commit b81c4a7 (circles.jsonl and circles_locate.jsonl, summarize.txt, per-K caches, logs and states, exits.txt, driver.txt, awake.py and .log, run_kf.sh and run_locate.sh, README). `raw_check.py` exits 0.

### Recommended tasks

1. **Extend the scan upward at D 45, M 48: kf 23, 25, 27.** What: the same two circles (1.11 with R 0.12, 2.057 with R 0.1) at each kf, then the real-axis sign pattern for the one that changes. Why: if the zero is a genuine mode, higher cuts keep exactly one zero in the 1.11 disc; if harmonics add junk zeros (the no-cut pair at D 30, #68), the winding grows or the zero moves. Acceptance: the 2.057 control winds +1 at each; the 1.11 winding per kf, and a setup that misses 1e-15 is reported as a stop (|F| rises with kf here). Depends on: #178.
2. **Perturbation of the kf 21 state (the test of #158), if the coordinator's script exists.** Why: a zero that moves by a much larger amount than the state's perturbation is weakly determined by it. Acceptance: the zero's displacement against the perturbation size, with a control zero (`lam_phys`) that must stay put. Depends on: #178, #158.
3. (From #170) locate the strip zeros at kf 21 (1.687 < |Im| < 5.061), which this scan does not cover.
Closed by macm3 with the summary above (extra zero absent at kf 13 to 19, present at kf 21 at 1.14 +- 0.03; raw I178-macm3 at b81c4a7).
